source: Codex re-probe c0 (owned stdin closed during sleep 12: the server exited 0 and its tool, code-mode host and sandbox groups were gone within 5 s), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; replayed as a server exit with the turn in flight; model/list reply spliced from re-probe cat (3 of 8 rows, descriptions neutralized); thread/start sandbox echo and turn/start sandboxPolicy adapted from the recorded read-only bound to dangerFullAccess (full, the only bound VIA admits); the recorded exit 0 and its one stderr line (timestamp and pid neutralized) end the replay as an exit step

params.prompt: Run the shell command sleep 12. Then say done.

expect.notes: The server process exits after the tool started, with no terminal: Host confirms the death, so Err(ServerLost) -> failed(server_lost), never resent (C2 §4.1 Persistent-server routes with no terminal). Cleanup follows the Server close or crash row: GroupAbsent for the server's own group (C2 §2 Interrupt table). The leftover report belongs to S-LEFTOVER and is not asserted here (C2 §4.2).
